changes.text: Resolved a game stability issue (which was in no way related to the Walk power).
Custom Villain Groups that were composed of both custom and non-custom critters would only spawn the custom critters in missions. This has been fixed.
Fixed a bug that could incorrectly exemplar players to a very low level when swapping missions.
The Walk Power now has a new Icon.
The Walk power is now interrupted by falling, swimming and sliding.
Fixed a bug with Walk where Increase Slow IO set bonuses were affecting walking speed
Fixed a bug with stunned enemies playing the Walk animation rather than the normal dizzy walk
